lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve aapanaa so sir lekhai laai ||
lines.translation: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gavaai kai rahan sach liv laai ||
lines.translation: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio tinaa birathaa janam gavaai ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਵੇਕਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man vekaaree veRiaa vekaaraa karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai agiaanee poojade daragah milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam deu poojeeai bin satigur boojh na paai ||
lines.translation: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam bhaanaa satiguroo kaa karamee palai paai ||
lines.translation: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the True Guru's Will. By His Grace this is received.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sevaa surat kamaavanee jo har bhaavai so thaai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit sadaa sukh hovai din raatee ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit simarat sabh kilavikh paap lahaatee ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins and misdeeds shall be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit daalad dukh bhukh sabh lahi jaatee ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere mukh guramukh preet lagaatee ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤੀ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jit mukh bhaag likhiaa dhur saachai har tit mukh naam japaatee ||13||
lines.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio sabad na keeto veechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar giaan na aaio miratak hai sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh pher paiaa mar ja(n)mai hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined through death and rebirth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis no aap karaae soi ||
lines.translation: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai karam paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach rate gurasabad siu tin sachee sadaa liv hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is forever True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no mele na vichhuRai sahaj samaavai soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They merge imperceptibly into God. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੋੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so bhagautee jou bhagava(n)tai jaanai ||
lines.translation: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee aap pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai ||
lines.translation: He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai har naam vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa bhagautee utam hoi ||
lines.translation: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach samaavai soi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kapat bhagautee kahaae ||
lines.translation: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d paarabraham kade na paae ||
lines.translation: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa kare a(n)tar mal laae ||
lines.translation: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar mal dhovai man kee jooth na jaae ||
lines.translation: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat siu baad rachaae ||
lines.translation: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin dukheeaa doojai bhaai rachaae ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam na chetai bahu karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa s metanaa na jaae ||
lines.translation: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve mokh na paae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਕੜਿ ਨ ਸਵਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se kaR na savaahee ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se tripat aghaahee ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa tin jam dar naahee ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death.
